title: Your Large Language Model is Secretly a Fairness Proponent and You Should Prompt it Like One
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and enhancing 'fairness' in LLMs, which is a core ethical concept. It specifically benchmarks the models on demographic attributes including religion (e.g., comparing perspectives on atheists and Jews) and includes evaluation topics on moral and social controversies such as the legalization of homosexuality and access to birth control.
